<?php
// E2E probe (test only): a stand-in for the parts of WooCommerce Pre-Orders that the gateway calls, plus a scenario suite.
// ASSUMPTIONS about the real plugin: a pre-order "charged upon release" is bought with a $0.00 total, waits in a status that is
// not a paid status, and on release the order total is restored and the action
// wc_pre_orders_process_pre_order_completion_payment_<gateway id> is fired with the order.
// Gateway HTTP is short-circuited and every request is recorded (secrets are never recorded). Nothing leaves the machine.
if ( isset( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) && 'suite' === $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Pre_Orders' ) ) { class WC_Pre_Orders {} }
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Pre_Orders_Order' ) ) {
		class WC_Pre_Orders_Order {
			public static function order_contains_pre_order( $order ) { $id = is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order; return ! empty( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['preorders'][ $id ] ); }
			public static function order_requires_payment_tokenization( $order ) { return self::order_contains_pre_order( $order ); }
		}
	}
}

add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) || 'suite' !== $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) { return; }
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	if ( function_exists( 'wc_load_cart' ) && null === WC()->session ) { wc_load_cart(); }

	$G = array( 'req' => array(), 'preorders' => array(), 'n' => 0 );
	$GLOBALS['cz_e2e'] = &$G;

	// A pre-order waits in a status that is not a paid status ("pre-ordered" in the real plugin; on-hold here).
	add_filter( 'woocommerce_payment_complete_order_status', function ( $status, $order_id ) { return empty( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['preorders'][ $order_id ] ) ? $status : 'on-hold'; }, 10, 2 );

	add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) use ( &$G ) {
		if ( false === strpos( (string) $url, 'transactiongateway' ) ) { return $pre; }
		parse_str( (string) $args['body'], $b );
		$keep = array( 'type', 'amount', 'currency', 'customer_vault', 'customer_vault_id', 'initiated_by', 'stored_credential_indicator', 'initial_transaction_id', 'billing_method', 'orderid', 'payment', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'email', 'zip', 'order_description' );
		$rec  = array();
		foreach ( $keep as $k ) { if ( isset( $b[ $k ] ) ) { $rec[ $k ] = $b[ $k ]; } }
		$rec['has_token'] = isset( $b['payment_token'] );
		$G['req'][] = $rec;
		++$G['n'];
		$type = $b['type'] ?? '';
		$body = 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&authcode=A1&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n'];
		if ( 'sale' === $type && ! empty( $b['customer_vault_id'] ) && (float) ( $b['amount'] ?? 0 ) < 1 ) { $body = 'response=2&responsetext=DECLINE&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n']; }
		if ( in_array( $type, array( 'sale', 'validate' ), true ) && ! empty( $b['payment_token'] ) && ( $b['customer_vault'] ?? '' ) === 'add_customer' ) { $body .= '&customer_vault_id=V-' . $G['n'] . '&cc_number=4xxxxxxxxxxx1111&cc_exp=1230&cc_type=visa'; }
		return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => $body, 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
	}, 10, 3 );

	$gw  = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways()['cardz3n_gateway'];
	$out = array();
	$run = function ( $label, $fn ) use ( &$G, &$out ) {
		$G['req'] = array();
		$res      = $fn();
		$out[ $label ] = array_merge( array( 'requests' => $G['req'] ), (array) $res );
	};
	$order = function ( $total = '20.00', $preorder = true, $currency = 'USD' ) use ( &$G ) {
		$o = wc_create_order();
		$o->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
		$o->set_currency( $currency );
		$o->set_total( $total );
		$o->set_billing_first_name( 'Pat' );
		$o->set_billing_last_name( 'Preorder' );
		$o->set_billing_email( 'e2e@example.test' );
		$o->set_billing_postcode( '89101' );
		$o->save();
		if ( $preorder ) { $G['preorders'][ $o->get_id() ] = true; }
		return $o;
	};
	$post = function ( $tok = 'tok-e2e' ) { $_POST = array( 'cardz3n_payment_token' => $tok, 'cardz3n_token_type' => 'card', 'cardz3n_payment_source' => 'card' ); };
	$meta = function ( $o ) { $o = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() ); return array( 'vault' => (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id' ), 'initial' => (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id' ) ); };
	$notes = function ( $o ) { return array_map( function ( $n ) { return wp_strip_all_tags( $n->content ); }, wc_get_order_notes( array( 'order_id' => $o->get_id() ) ) ); };
	$hook = 'wc_pre_orders_process_pre_order_completion_payment_cardz3n_gateway';
	// What Pre-Orders does at release: restore the full total, then fire the action.
	$release = function ( $o, $total = '20.00' ) use ( $hook ) {
		unset( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['preorders'][ $o->get_id() ] ); // released: no longer waiting
		$o = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() ); $o->set_total( $total ); $o->save();
		do_action( $hook, wc_get_order( $o->get_id() ) );
		return wc_get_order( $o->get_id() );
	};

	// 1) Pre-order bought with a $0.00 total: the card is verified and saved, nothing is charged.
	$run( 'purchase_zero', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $meta ) {
		$o = $order( '0.00' ); $post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() ); $o2 = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'paid' => $o2->is_paid(), 'order' => $meta( $o ) );
	} );
	// 2) The same pre-order, but the order shows the full total at checkout (charge on release): still no charge today.
	$run( 'purchase_full_total', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $meta ) {
		$o = $order( '20.00' ); $post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() ); $o2 = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'paid' => $o2->is_paid(), 'order' => $meta( $o ) );
	} );
	// 3) Release: charged once from the saved card with the later-payment fields.
	$run( 'release', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $meta, $release, $notes, &$G ) {
		$o = $order( '0.00' ); $post(); $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$G['req'] = array();
		$o2 = $release( $o );
		return array( 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'paid' => $o2->is_paid(), 'txn' => (string) $o2->get_transaction_id(), 'order' => $meta( $o ), 'notes' => $notes( $o2 ) );
	} );
	// 4) Release fired twice: charged once.
	$run( 'release_twice', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $release, &$G ) {
		$o = $order( '0.00' ); $post(); $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$G['req'] = array();
		$release( $o ); $o2 = $release( $o );
		return array( 'status' => $o2->get_status() );
	} );
	// 5) Release with no saved card anywhere: fails with a clear note, nothing is sent.
	$run( 'release_no_card', function () use ( $order, $release, $notes ) {
		$o = $order( '0.00' ); $o2 = $release( $o );
		return array( 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'notes' => $notes( $o2 ) );
	} );
	// 6) Release with a declined card: the order fails.
	$run( 'release_declined', function () use ( $order, $release, $notes ) {
		$o = $order( '0.00' ); $o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-DECLINE' ); $o->save();
		$o2 = $release( $o, '0.50' );
		return array( 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'notes' => $notes( $o2 ) );
	} );
	// 7) Release for an order that has no card of its own, but the customer has a saved card.
	$run( 'release_customer_card', function () use ( $order, $release ) {
		\Cardz3n_Gateway\Token_Service::save_card_token( 1, 'cardz3n_gateway', 'V-CUSTOMER', array( 'last4' => '1111', 'exp_month' => '12', 'exp_year' => '2030', 'brand' => 'visa', 'initial_txn_id' => 'TX-CUST' ) );
		$o = $order( '0.00' ); $o->set_customer_id( 1 ); $o->save();
		$o2 = $release( $o );
		return array( 'status' => $o2->get_status() );
	} );
	// 8) Release of an order that is already paid: nothing is sent.
	$run( 'release_already_paid', function () use ( $order, $release ) {
		$o = $order( '20.00', false ); $o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-X' ); $o->save(); $o->payment_complete( 'TX-PAID' );
		$o2 = $release( $o );
		return array( 'status' => $o2->get_status() );
	} );
	// 9) A normal order is untouched.
	$run( 'normal_order', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post ) {
		$o = $order( '20.00', false ); $post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );

	echo wp_json_encode( $out );
	exit;
}, 20 );
